title: Add exact C3 shared-source fanout obstruction
body:
## Result

Adds a source-pinned exact finite obstruction for a hypothetical C3 shared-source child on the selected width-73 word. The bounded family consists of every three-consecutive-ADD window in A or B with one unchanged source, three distinct destinations, zero source-frame climb, and at least two positive target climbs.

The replay reconstructs the pinned word's full profile, finds 32 qualifying windows, and uses exact weighted interval scheduling. Its max-weight schedule contains 25 windows and gives a hypothetical zero-interface-cost ceiling gain of 0.9065527351%. More strongly, maximizing certified per-window moment-saving upper bounds over every allowed non-overlapping schedule still leaves the moment above one at the five-percent target, with exact positive margin in `CERTIFICATE.json`.

The verifier checks each arbitrary-dirty rational four-register map and its inverse. All added fanout, copies, helpers, hosting, frame conversion, restoration, and precision costs are set to zero for the favorable screen. This is a scoped negative for this selected-word consecutive-window C3 family; it admits no physical supplier and makes no new kappa claim.

## Pins and reproduction

The package records seed `c309ff190ac582a9bdcf59a3422822e8`, priority revision 3, exact base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`, selected-record hash, selected-source/certificate hashes, and compressed/decompressed word hashes. `SOURCES.json` pins source blobs at that base.

From the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-source-frame-fanout-seedc309 --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-source-frame-fanout-seedc309
```

Local verification completed with Python 3.14.7: the exact verifier passed, all six focused positive/negative controls passed, package metadata and source-pin validation passed, and `git diff --check` passed. Python 3.12 is not installed in the local environment, so the registered Python 3.12 replay was not run locally.

## Scope and credit

The result does not cover nonconsecutive or reordered gates, other fanout arities, other words, changed coverage laws, or physical C3 admission. It builds on the selected PR1094 construction and the PR1240 local ceiling/PR1012 coverage identity. Related work PR1756 and PR1764/Discussion 1765 is distinguished in the package. Substantial AI assistance from OpenAI Codex is disclosed in `TASK.json` and `README.md`.
